title: Healthcare & Medical Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free HIPAA-compliant template to request your medical records, data deletion, or privacy information from healthcare providers and health apps.
description: Protect your medical privacy with this comprehensive letter template. Request your health records, delete personal data from health apps, or inquire about privacy practices at healthcare facilities under HIPAA regulations.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]

[Date]

[Healthcare Provider/Company Name]
Attn: Privacy Officer
[Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: HIPAA Privacy Request - [REQUEST TYPE]

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request [ACCESS TO/DELETION OF/INFORMATION ABOUT] my protected health information (PHI) as permitted under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule, 45 CFR § 164.524.

Patient Information:
- Full Name: [YOUR FULL NAME]
- Date of Birth: [YOUR DOB]
- Patient ID/Account Number: [IF KNOWN]
- Service Dates: [DATE RANGE OR SPECIFIC DATES]

sections.heading: Specific Request Details
sections.content:
I am specifically requesting:

☐ Complete medical records including:
 - Progress notes and consultation reports
 - Test results and imaging studies
 - Prescription and medication history
 - Billing and insurance information

☐ Data deletion/restriction:
 - Delete all personal health information
 - Restrict sharing of my data with third parties
 - Opt-out of marketing communications

☐ Privacy practices information:
 - Copy of your Notice of Privacy Practices
 - List of disclosures made in the past 6 years
 - Information about data sharing with business associates

Preferred format: ☐ Electronic copy ☐ Paper copy ☐ Secure patient portal

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Timeline
sections.content:
Under HIPAA regulations, I understand that:
- You have 30 days to respond to this request (with possible 30-day extension)
- You may charge reasonable fees for copying and mailing
- I have the right to file a complaint with HHS if this request is improperly denied

If you deny this request, please provide written explanation citing specific legal grounds for denial and information about my right to request a review of the denial.

For health apps and digital platforms: I also request information about any data sharing with third-party advertisers, data brokers, or other companies not directly involved in my healthcare.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity, I am providing:
☐ Copy of government-issued photo ID
☐ Signed authorization form (if required)
☐ Additional verification: [SPECIFY]

If additional verification is needed, please contact me at [PHONE NUMBER] or [EMAIL ADDRESS].

For security purposes, please send any electronic records using encrypted email or through a secure patient portal. I recommend using secure browsers like a privacy-focused browser when accessing health records online to protect against tracking.

sections.heading: Closing and Contact Information
sections.content:
Please acknowledge receipt of this request within 5 business days and provide an estimated timeline for completion. If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact me immediately.

I expect a response within the HIPAA-mandated timeframe. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

Enclosures: [List any documents attached]

Deleting personal data from health and fitness apps
Getting copies of test results and imaging studies
Requesting privacy practices from telehealth platforms
Obtaining disclosure history of your health information
Restricting sharing of reproductive health data
